main.description: One act on mutualpulse (mutualpulse.bisks.net), a live pulse-board of mutual aid — food shared, rides given, skills taught, a fence fixed, company kept — logged by whoever gave or received it. Any atproto account may write one; the site reads the whole network for this collection (com.atproto.sync.listReposByCollection + Jetstream) and turns it into a glowing, ambient feed. Deliberately not a ledger: no amount, no dollar value, no per-person leaderboard — the point is that care isn't a debt to be tallied, just a pulse worth noticing. Written and read by mutualpulse (https://mutualpulse.bisks.net).

category.description: What kind of act this is. food (a meal, groceries, a shared table), ride (a lift, a tow, help getting somewhere), repair (fixed something — a fence, a tire, a leak), care (company, a check-in, someone who listened or sat with you), skill (a lesson, a haircut, teaching a trade), shelter (a place to stay, a spare room, warmth), other (anything else worth a pulse).

text.description: One line: what happened. Plain and specific — 'brought soup for three days', 'fixed my neighbor's fence, no charge'. Not a story, just the pulse.

place.description: Optional, and deliberately loose — a neighborhood, a city, 'my block'. This is not a map of where anyone lives; keep it vague on purpose.

createdAt.description: When this act happened or was logged, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
